overview: The river goes up the mountain

title: YOSHIKI CLASSICAL 2026 in LOS ANGELES at WALT DISNEY CONCERT HALL “VIOLET NIGHT”
Fractured 3
overview: When Red and Chloe alter the past to save their families, they return to a fractured present where they are suddenly parents to teenage daughters, their oldest allies have become vicious enemies, and a stolen temporal pocket watch threatens to wipe Wonderland off the map forever.

title: Sonatax
overview: Vasco, a young pianist, spends entire nights practicing after a mysterious musician shows him his true potential. His world changes as the piano consumes more and more of his life.

title: The Living Dragon
overview: For more than half a century, Yasuaki Kurata has been one of the most prominent and singular Japanese actors in international action cinema. After becoming a major star in Hong Kong during the Golden Age of kung fu films - appearing alongside such icons as Jackie Chan, Sammo Hung, Jet Li and Donnie Yen - Kurata now marks both the 60th anniversary of his acting career and his 80th birthday with an ambitious and deeply personal new project, "The Living Dragon."  Structured as an anthology of three interconnected stories, the film brings together leading action directors Koichi Sakamoto, Kenji Tanigaki and Yuji Shimomura - all former members of the Kurata Action Club, who went on to earn their own fame in Japan and abroad. Moving between realism, fantasy and memory, the stories they've written for their sifu revolve around aging, unrealized dreams and the enduring spirit of those who continue to devote themselves to cinema.

title: Dead Parents Club
overview: Dead Parents Club is a hybrid documentary blending observational footage, experimental performance, and cultural analysis to challenge the pervasive "orphan trope" in popular culture.  While children's media like The Lion King, Frozen, and Finding Nemo frequently use parental loss as a narrative tool to spark a character's independence, the lived reality of grief is vastly more complex.  The film follows real individuals who have lost parents as they collaborate on a unique theatre production. By stepping into the roles of iconic fictional orphans like Simba and Frodo, the cast members weave their personal stories of trauma into the scripted scenes. The resulting performance offers a poignant, absurd, and unexpectedly funny exploration of identity and healing.  Moving between fantasy and lived experience, this documentary examines how we navigate profound loss, build deep connections, and ultimately learn to parent ourselves.

title: A Shadow in the Corner of the Room
overview: Down-on-her-luck nurse, Avery, dismisses a care home resident's warnings of a shadowy presence as dementia...until it begins to turn its attention to her.

title: Capps Crossing: Wrong Side of Dead
overview: When a behavioral science major investigates murders at Capps Crossing, she finds herself trapped in a twisted web of lies surrounding the local ranger and his son.

title: Silent Verses
overview: A stuttering young boy, pressured by his father, finds solace in his bicycle—until a troubled boy steals it, leading to an unlikely friendship.

title: Poultrygeist II: Dawn of the Chicken Dead
overview: A global poultry pandemic sets the stage for a wealthy tech tycoon to attempt to relaunch a failed fast-food empire using lab-grown synthetic chicken. Things go horribly wrong when these artificial food supplies unleash a wave of mutant chicken zombies.

title: The Beast of Gevautwo
overview: Six months after the events of the first film, we find the mayor still alive at the bar, the beast is striking again, so they’ll have to fight back...

title: Snowbound for the Holidays
overview: Hotel manager Cassidy Evergreen evaluates a cozy ski lodge, but Christmas magic—and its charming owner, Trey Sanderson—turn a simple assignment into a heartfelt choice between duty and love.

title: Batter Up, Queen!
overview: Drag queen Frannie P. Bodied takes on the most mortifying gig of her career: babysitting a bubbly child baseball player.

title: Tight Lettuce
overview: A son films his father's addiction, hoping to document his recovery; but as he sacrifices everything to save him, he must decide how much he'll lose for someone who may not want saving.

title: Don't Dodge Life
overview: A jaded grocery store employee drifting through his bleak routine encounters a man by the name of Life.  Through his conversations with Life, the protagonist's ideas slowly begin to shift.

title: I Don't Know What I'm Doing Here
overview: Mima, an American college student, embarks on a road trip to the rural Romanian village where her grandmother, Esther, was born. Her friend Jacob, a recent film-school dropout, joins her in the old country, along with an 18-year-old translator whom she found on Facebook. Decades after Esther’s death, Mima relies on her grandmother’s unmarked photos of the village and recorded oral history to orient herself in the remote area. As the trio scale walls and trek through fields searching for any evidence of Esther’s life in Romania, the deeper unknowns animating Mima's journey begin to reveal themselves.

title: Occupation
overview: Friends Sam and Grace have to move in with a man they barely know. A man who soon proves to be a nightmare to live with.

title: A Long Ride Home
overview: Mick learns about the death of his father through a phone call. Now he needs to return to a home he hasn't been to in 25 years to face his Demons.  Director J. Robert Bellamy originally wanted this story to be told in film format, but would only get funding to make it as a series for Bell Fibe. This version is his definitive vision.

title: Water Park Shark
overview: Sharks breach a seaside water park during the debut of a new ride, forcing a lifeguard and the town’s police chief to contain the chaos and protect guests from becoming prey.

title: Rave
overview: A masked DJ slices and dices his way through an afterparty in the Hollywood Hills.

title: Emetophobia
overview: A child embarks on a dark journey through his house to tell his mother he vomited in his room.

title: In The Middle Of Something
overview: During the worst gig of his life, a piano player wrestling with failure, fatherhood, and marriage has a surreal encounter that suggests he's been playing the wrong song all along.

title: BAGA : Tomorrow Belongs to No One
overview: Set in a conservative seaside village on Malaysia’s East Coast, BAGA follows Jani and Melur, two young lovers trapped between inherited realities and dreams of escape. When an unexpected pregnancy forces them into a difficult choice, Jani turns to the drug trade in a desperate attempt to secure their future. As love collides with addiction, poverty, and tradition, the couple must confront the cost of survival in a community where opportunities are scarce and every choice carries consequences.

title: Amityville Alone
overview: Meet Ricky, an 8 year old boy neglected by his father. When Santa forgets to put his presents under the tree, Ricky gets granted three Christmas miracles by the Tree Witch. He wishes to be BIG, he wishes to be HOME ALONE, and finally, he wishes for his E.T.special friend Tito to go from being a dog to a full speaking humanoid. But once Ricky gets in trouble with a local gangster, he and Tito will have to fight for their right... to party!

title: Memories of Flesh and Bone
overview: In the capital of southern Brazil in the 1890s, a beautiful and mysterious couple gained notoriety, both for the achievements of the husband, Dr. Gustavo Ramos, and for the morbid personality of his wife, Katalina Paulsen.  When fear strikes, terrible secrets are revealed.

title: Prompt: Make a Documentary
overview: Prompt: Make a Documentary investigates the growing influence of artificial intelligence on the film industry.  The documentary places the rise of AI within the broader historical context of cinema’s evolution, drawing parallels with earlier technological shifts such as the introduction of sound, colour, and digital visual effects. By revisiting landmark moments in film history, the film demonstrates that disruption has always been part of cinema’s DNA, while questioning whether AI represents a fundamentally different kind of change.  Featuring insights from directors, academics, and practitioners, Prompt: Make a Documentary explores the tension between innovation and integrity, the democratisation of creative tools, and the ethical implications of automation in the arts. The film ultimately asks whether artificial intelligence will empower the next generation of storytellers or redefine creativity itself.

title: Hallway Monitor
overview: George's sister is sick. Trying his best to take care of her, the twelve year old boy spends all hospital visits inspecting the hallway for anything that might put her in danger. When his routine inspection is interrupted, George must face the danger all around him.

title: Sweet Rogue Killer
overview: After destroying the Forelli empire, SRK discovers that the last surviving Forelli bloodline is secretly rebuilding its power through corruption and political influence. As a dangerous conspiracy threatens the township once again, SRK launches a final mission to expose the truth, eliminate the heir, and end the Forelli legacy forever.

title: Fix
overview: When Victoria, a pharmaceutical executive, discovers her long-lost brother Damian is homeless and struggling with addiction, she takes a bold step-secretly administering an experimental drug to help him get back on his feet. All seems to be going well until the drug runs out.

title: JULY
overview: During a seemingly ordinary school vacation, eight-year-old Diego struggles to understand why his older brother, Nicco, has suddenly become distant. While Diego clings to the simple rituals that once brought them together, Nicco retreats further into silence, carrying a pain no one around him fully sees. As memories of happier Julys blur with the present, Diego is forced to confront a reality beyond his understanding. Through the eyes of a child, JULY explores the quiet weight of depression, the bonds between siblings, and the small acts of love that can become lifelines in moments of darkness.

title: Soulmate
overview: Jalte spends most of his time in the digital worlds of virtual reality. In his loneliness, he creates Selina – an AI companion designed to become his perfect Soulmate.

title: Echoes In Time
overview: When computer engineer Luke Molan inadvertently discovers a way to travel through time, he uses the technology to go back and warn his wife, Peta, of an impending cancer diagnosis.

title: Women Calling
overview: Morgane wakes up after a sexual assault to the sound of a female voice whispering her name. She tries to seek help and make her way home, but strange occurrences appear on her path. Apparitions of women clothed in identical red sheets, incomprehensible phone calls, and hands reaching out toward her disrupt her journey. Morgane loses control of her body and consciousness, forced to relive the night that sealed her fate. She becomes trapped in a nightmare from which she cannot escape. Her only way out might require for blood to be bled.

title: Splash City
overview: A coming-of-age thriller set against the backdrop of 'the real and raw subculture of the San Francisco Bay Area'.

title: Doglady
overview: Through interaction within the objects in her bag, a half-human, half-dog being known as the Doglady begins to understand each facet of her existence and being.

title: Rumours Of Madam Roach
overview: In a small factory town far north, sits Madam Roach, the window watcher. Retreat from reality, and infused with a toxic spore, the lesbian gossip master prides her time monitoring neighbours through a pair of world altering binoculars

title: BLS - Body Life Support
overview: An awkward first aid instructor seeks intimacy with his student. Their questionable contact is fleeting, but for a silent witness from afar, it leaves a lifelong imprint.

title: No Way Home
overview: A young man checks into a secluded hotel room, expecting an ordinary night. But when a series of unsettling, anonymous phone calls begins and a terrifying, otherworldly entity appears in the desolate parking lot below, the boundaries of reality start to warp. Trapped in a claustrophobic, seemingly endless labyrinth of shifting corridors and malfunctioning elevators, he must escape a shifting nightmare where every door leads back to where he started.

title: Men Behind Bars
overview: Inmate Rex is transferred to a new prison after allegations of abuse against the prison service. Waiting down in the solitary confinement unit is the governor's human weapon, Darrell, now in his daddy era—what will Rex do to survive?

title: Alien Storm
overview: A father, businessman and secret doomsday prepper escorts people to the safety of his bunker – actually an underground house – when a massive and potentially deadly fog descends and cuts the power at his home.

title: Horror and Love
overview: A love letter to the world of freaks, this documentary retraces the birth of Horrorland, voted Europe's Best Scream Park, as well as the love story between Cristina Raya and David Moreno, the two main driving forces behind this Catalan theme park. From St. Louis to Vilassar de Dalt, by way of Newcastle, the camera accompanies them on their odyssey to build a dream called Horrorland.

title: Someone's Daughter
overview: A criminal defence lawyer, Sam, (Pascale Bussières, Ma Vie en cinémascope, When Night is Falling), finds herself kidnapped and abandoned on a remote island along with former client Paul (François Arnaud, Heated Rivalry, Fucktoys, The Borgias), who she previously cleared of sexual assault charges. As they make their way through the unrelenting Canadian wilderness, Paul’s behaviour forces Sam to question the man she once defended. As doubt gives way to fear, she finds herself facing a choice no lawyer should ever have to make.

title: Fruitless
overview: Oscar, an aspiring fashion designer, is faced with a painful decision following the events of a turbulent night..

title: Depths of Fear
overview: A team of divers enters one of the deepest holes in the ocean, but they discover more than they expected: something has made that deep hole its home and now they will have to fight for survival.

title: Permanent Damage
overview: Prison escapee Tommy Gods spirals into deeper trouble when he falls for Joe Plísek and is forced to work for her crooked uncle. Together, the couple plots to steal his "golden goose."

title: FESTER
overview: Unable to digest the end of his relationship, Robert develops a haunting gut-rot that sends him spiraling down the toilet... and into his ex-girlfriend's new lover's apartment.

title: CONATUS
overview: Soyeong, a woman with a disability, harbors a nightly dream: performing on stage. In her imagination, she dances effortlessly in a "normal" body, yet remains wary of praise. Her dance teacher, Heejeong, guides her through movements, encouraging her to chase her aspirations. Their shared performance is a cherished moment, but the following day brings a return to Soyeong's ordinary life. As she begins documenting her experiences, we embark on a journey alongside her, through changing seasons and flowing waters, towards an unknown destination.

title: Comédie-Française
overview: At the Comédie-Française, there is one golden rule: the play is never canceled. Unfortunately for Nina, everything else is—just three hours before the premiere of her first staging. An actor is stuck on a train, tensions explode, equipment breaks down, egos clash, and panic sets in. With no way out and time slipping away, Nina must hold the show together at all costs. Will she make it until the curtain rises?

title: Take Care of Yourself
overview: The story revolves around a couple who face numerous recurring disagreements and problems, leading them to a series of humorous and unexpected situations.

title: The Disconnection
overview: Luke is pressured by a pair of stereotypical bullies to get a new phone, so he enlists the help of his unpredictable, dumb friend Liam, but their mission quickly spirals into chaos when a pair of rich, phone-obsessed twins enter the classroom, turning a simple task into a ridiculous, absurd adventure.

title: The Fire We Choose
overview: Brian, a newly married outsider in a religious extremist family, is torn between faith and morality when the Wards kidnap a lesbian couple, Kennedy and Mia, determined to save them at any cost.

title: Ballad Of The Trumpet
overview: An inexperienced robber brings his obnoxious best friend along for his last job. But, as the night grows colder; dark secrets and horrific truths are revealed.

title: Role Models
overview: Role Models follows Sophie, Erin and Fletch as they spend the day recovering from a part from the night before. Erin who ruined the party by letting it slip that the birthday girl cheated on her boyfriend. Spends the day on the couch thinking about what she’s done, out of pity fletch offers to go to the shops for her which is. Decision he would soon regret. On the flip side of all of this Sophie spends the day setting up to do a dj set at what she presumes is a night club as she arrives it soon becomes clear she’s made a mistake

title: Bangungot
overview: In a quiet rural town in the outskirts of the Philippines, an impoverished young man dreaming of a better life finds himself ensnared by the Batibat during his sleep, causing him to enter a deceptive dream of comfort and wonder that slowly turns into a calming nightmare in which he may never wake up again— nor the rest of the town.

title: Motor City
overview: In 1970s Detroit, John Miller falls for a local gangster's girl and lands in prison for a crime he didn't commit. With his life ruined, Miller plots revenge against the man who took his girl away.

title: Blood on Snow
overview: A hit man falls for his client's wife, who happens to be the target of the assassin's latest assignment.

title: Pacific
overview: A group of young travelers are stranded on an island in the Pacific where they struggle to escape an evil presence kept hidden from mankind for centuries.

title: I, Object
overview: 10-year-old Tom, grieving the loss of his father and unable to relate to the people in his life, takes refuge in the everyday objects around him. Pop can lids, suitcases and untold numbers of everyday objects reveal their true faces and speak to him, helping him on his healing journey.

title: To my sisters
overview: Four women are on an existential journey in Morocco, connecting with local women from all walks of life bonding in sisterhood, and share their common quest for empowerment.

title: Pinocchio: Unstrung
overview: Influenced by a sinister Cricket and created by Geppetto, Pinocchio launches a violent crusade to carve himself into a real boy like his brother James, one piece at a time.

title: Future Future
overview: In a rainy Brazilian city, an amnesic man is taken in by a lonely clickworker at a course for people with a strange neurological syndrome. After using an addictive AI device, he embarks on a tragic and absurd journey to find where he truly belongs.

title: Little Creatures
overview: Brasília, 1986. Helena has barely settled in with her family in Brazil's futuristic capital when her husband leaves on a business trip. Stranded in an unfamiliar city, she questions her choices, feeling frustrated and lost. Her teenage son rebels and discovers his first love; her seven-year-old finds magic in unlikely friendships and unseen possibilities. In a democracy less than a year old, everyone lives in limbo—trapped between what was and what could be.

title: Mojoku Hilang!
overview: Adi, a corporate climber at Moo Magic Farms who turns a distinctive cow named Mojo into a viral sensation while pursuing aggressive rural farm acquisitions. His plans take an unexpected turn when he encounters a resistant farming community and its determined inhabitants.

title: Hasta el fin del mundo
overview: Manuel's life is upended when Esmeralda, his lost love from 15 years ago, calls unexpectedly. Despite being set to marry another, he rediscovers Esmeralda, and they realize their love transcends time.

title: Penny Lane Is Dead
overview: Set in 1986, during a scorching Aussie summer, three best friends' celebration at a beach house turns into a blood-soaked fight for survival when a prank goes horribly wrong.

title: Her Private Hell
overview: When a mysterious mist engulfs a futuristic metropolis, unleashing a deadly and elusive entity, a troubled young woman searches for her father. Her quest collides with an American GI on a harrowing odyssey to rescue his daughter from Hell.

title: I Rarely Wake Up Dreaming
overview: Olha and Oleh live in Ukraine as LGBTQ+ individuals. However, Russia's war of aggression is putting the couple's identity and love to the test.

title: Mil Luas
overview: At 80 years old, Chiara, an immigrant woman, single mother, and independent soul, sees her world collapse with the sale of the restaurant she built while pursuing the dream of a better life for her daughter. Between memories and losses, she rediscovers her strength, her autonomy, and the freedom to start over, proving that it is never too late to choose herself.

title: Honey Bunny
overview: Tonina has always taken care of her family, however she never felt like they really reciprocated her with an equal amount of help and love. Believing that it's her given right, she decides to aquire the ownership rights to a small family holiday home on the island of Hvar. However, after the rest of her kin realize what she had done, tensions begin to brew and a small family gathering turns into a turf war.

title: Dream High
overview: A cinematic rock opera and an homage to teen films, adapted from the stage musical with the same name by Amit Ulman, scripted completely in Hebrew rhymes. Yoav, a teenage boy who lives with his single mother, who struggles to finance them, moves to a new city. He joins Magshimim High, where words hit harder than punches, and your rhyming skills determine the food chain. After the "class king" demolishes him in a rap battle, Yoav is determined to prove himself and win the heart of the "class queen", Maya. He encounters Hamorabi, a legendary former rapper who hides under the image of the school's kiosk cashier. With his help, Yoav turns from an outcast to the Star of the Battles. But as he climbs high, he draws apart from the friends who stood by his side, the girl who really saw him when no one else had, and the authenticity taught to him by Hamorabi. In the National Rap Championship, Yoav will have to choose between chasing the shining lights of fame or staying true to himself.

title: Ecos do Teatro Experimental do Negro
My Wild Friend: Returning Home
overview: When Sasha meets his wild friend, Red the fox, again, he learns that the fox's family has been kidnapped by a traveling zoo. The boy resolves to bring them home at all costs. A dangerous journey and a meeting with a new true friend awaits him.

title: Home Bodies
overview: Two children, raised in total isolation by an automated house, begin to confront the mysteries of their existence after an enigmatic stranger arrives from outside.

title: Love in Slow Motion
overview: When Haya's best friend Jawad gets engaged, her chronically-single world unravels — because who knew true love could be hiding in the friend zone?

title: "It's Murder!"
overview: Officer Wray is determined to prove to his boss that he has what it takes to bring justice for an innocent victim involved in a murder case gone wrong. His boss assigns him onto a recent murder case involving 7 suspects who all had the potential to have committed this murder. As Officer Wray digs deeper into this mystery, with the help of a key witness and a helpful journalist, the situation becomes more and more dangerous for not just himself, but for everyone involved...

title: The Debt Collector
overview: Haunted by guilt after prison, a former debt collector races against a terminal illness, returning to his old world to avenge loan shark victims.

title: Mosquito Halo
overview: Police investigate Dream Harvester, a political faction opposing the digitization of consciousness.

title: Fake Hundreds
overview: After a cancer diagnosis, a man tries to confront God.

title: Butterfly Effect: Azzam
overview: Azzam a 12-year-old boy is suddenly transported to an isolated world of butterflies during a family trip to the south of Saudi Arabia. Transformed into a butterfly, he must find himself to find his way back to the real world and his family.

title: A Malevolent World
overview: A full improv feature film that explores the awful realism of a zombie apocalypse in Northern England.

title: Juminten Edan
overview: Juminten, a mute woman, returns to her hometown with her husband and child after eight years away. Initially welcomed warmly by her family, their happiness changes when Juminten begins to behave strangely and endanger those closest to her. When her dark past is revealed, the safety of her family and the entire island is threatened.

title: Sihir Tanah Kubur
overview: After his mother's death, Yusuf is shocked when his younger brother, Ashar, moves her grave due to a mysterious will. The appearance of the Wurung Tomb triggers a mystical terror that divides the family and the villagers. Amidst the escalating conflict, dark family secrets are revealed, posing a demonic threat that jeopardizes their future.

title: Anak-Anak Bambu
overview: Netta planned to sell the orphanage to solve her family's problems. However, after getting to know the orphans living there, especially Gebang, she realized that family isn't just about blood ties, but about caring for each other. This journey led Netta to discover the meaning of family that had been missing from her life.

title: Behind the Screens
overview: Seven close friends reunite for a dinner gathering and decide to play a seemingly harmless game. Throughout the evening, every message, email, and phone call they receive must be shared openly with the group.

title: Sia: Nostalgic for the Present
overview: A bold experience that challenges the genre that trades pop poetry for pure art. Impressive voices, impressive choreography and iconic performances, captured cinematically and sounded by an unparalleled catalog of hits.

title: Free Wifi
overview: Davi, an online motorcycle taxi driver, fakes a wealthy image on social media to attract Grace's attention. Their relationship is opposed by Grace's ex-fiancé, who hires a detective to uncover Davi's true identity. The revelation of the truth triggers a series of misunderstandings, conflicts, and chaos involving both families.

title: 72 HOURS
overview: After he's inadvertently added to their group text, a forty-year-old executive hopes to save his flailing career by joining a group of twenty-somethings on a wild three-day bachelor party.

title: Karavali
overview: Karavali is a film that explores the struggles between man and nature, set against the raw, untamed beauty of coastal Karnataka. The story revolves around the world of Kambala, a traditional annual buffalo race, showcasing the unique culture and challenges of the region.

title: The Dink
overview: Desperate to save a struggling country club and earn his father's respect, a washed-up tennis pro is compelled to break a sacred vow and do the unthinkable: play pickleball.

title: A Palette for Murder
overview: Six seeming unrelated men receive mysterious invitations to a lavish dinner at the mansion of the enigmatic Count Reginald Black. As they gather in the opulent, eerie residence, they find themselves wrapped in a web of intrigue, each hiding secrets, motives, and personal stakes that could be their undoing.

title: Chennai Love Story
overview: Two young people navigate their first experience of love, dealing with its powerful emotions and obstacles while discovering the delicate nature of newfound romance.

title: Don Quijote in Barcelona
overview: Lluc, a former academic with strong cultural ties, and Olli, a man who drifted from Finland to the streets of Barcelona, meet while seeking shelter in the same stairwell. Their beginnings are modest, but gradually a connection develops between them, based not on pity but on shared humanity.

title: Shambhala Story
overview: In the Himalayan foothills town of Darjeeling, India, a devout Tibetan Buddhist monk named Tashi is sent to Japan to continue his spiritual training. There, he meets a cantankerous elderly man and his parolee granddaughter, Emi. As Tashi grows closer to them, the distance between the lonely Emi and Tashi begins to shrink, and forbidden feelings start to emerge between them.

title: Katukutu Buro
overview: Directorial debut of Ujaan Ganguly.

title: Fifth Mission
overview: A methodical hitman kills those he believes are beyond justice. When a detective whose brother he murdered begins to hunt him, the chase becomes personal, blurring the line between law, revenge, and morality, and asking how far justice can bend before it is justice no more?

title: Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of the Mermaid Island
overview: Chiikawa and friends set off on a whimsical summer adventure to a mysterious island said to hide a long-lost mermaid secret. What starts as a fun getaway quickly turns into a heartwarming journey filled with surprises, gentle thrills, and adorable chaos. With sparkling seas, strange legends, and unforgettable encounters, the trio learns about courage, friendship, and the magic hidden in small moments.

title: The Taro Donatella Story
overview: From Underdog to legend - From silence to legend. The Taro Donatella Story is the true rise of a man who built an empire alone. A journey of ambition, obsession, and belief in the impossible. - "Mark Zuckerberg & Taro Donatella. One code. One invention. Who actually created the real-time algorithm? The truth behind the biggest lie in social media history - Coming Summer 2026."

title: The Actor
overview: A young actor attempts to finish their self audition tape. But a series of never ending interruptions sends him into an existential spiral.

title: la fille aux talons d'argile
overview: Essay film based on the homonymous book  by Juliet Berto.

title: All Wishes Come True
overview: Eight grassroot mortals use their street smarts and hilarious schemes to defy powerful gods, earning their title as the "Eight Immortals."

title: Trouxe o Doce?
overview: A nervous courier delivers a mysterious package to a rich drug boss on a remote road, but when their deal reveals an unexpected twist, a sudden police chase turns a simple exchange into a high-stakes fight to escape.

title: Ishqnama
overview: ‘ISHQNAMA’ True Story of True Lovers NIMMA–NASIMA

title: Sana: Play with Me
overview: Right before summer vacation, a "forbidden game" is secretly played at a high school. After some students take part in it, their ordinary days begin to change, and before long, a "certain incident" occurs. Taking the situation seriously, the school brings in a counselor, Koharu, to provide mental care for the students who witnessed the incident. However, one of the students who played the "game" turns out to be Koharu's sister, Nanami. One by one, the students are drawn into bizarre phenomena.

title: The Truthers
overview: After her mother's sudden death, Ruth returns to her hometown and reunites with her father, whose odd behavior makes her question what really happened.

title: Eiga Kamen Raidā Zettsu Sayonara no Misshon
overview: Baku Yorozu/Kamen Rider ZEZTZ is accused of terrorism by the National Public Safety Commission. Convinced of his innocence, Kensei Odaka/Kamen Rider NOX pursues the true culprit, and finally tracks down the mastermind behind it all, National Public Safety Commission Chairman, Shuma Kumon/Kamen Rider Mugen.

title: Chō Uchū Keiji Gyaban Infiniti Taiyō ga Naita Hi
overview: Negative Emorgy emanating from MultiEarth A0073 coalesced into a massive void that swallowed the sun. The world lost its light and was engulfed in deep darkness. The most formidable enemy, Gavan Killer, who aims to annihilate all Gavans, pushes Reiji and his friends into an unprecedented life or death situation.

title: Ricochets
overview: Deeply affected by a series of unlikely and violent events in his youth, a solitary man has a fortuitous encounter.

title: The Indian Story
overview: A community confronts the devastating impact of pesticide contamination as industrial negligence threatens public health. The fight for accountability exposes systemic failures in regulatory oversight and corporate responsibility.

title: Return to My Blue
overview: A documentary about some disabled children go on a trip to a deserted island in Okinawa.

title: Untitled Film By Connor Titus
overview: Two friends are having a sleepover and when one thing is said it all goes wrong

title: Rising Embers
overview: Two thousand years. One truth. Carried by ordinary people who refused to let their faith be silenced.

title: 24 Jump Street
overview: The third installment in the franchise. Plot TBA.

title: A Part of Me
overview: A Friendship crossing twenty years.

title: Justice
overview: The online child safety taskforce, "Predator Puncherz", document their latest and most infamous sting operation.

title: Faithless
overview: After a personal loss, Savannah’s grief begins to distort her perception of reality. As she tries to understand what she is experiencing, her sense of faith, memory, and truth begins to break down.

title: Insectasy
overview: Sadie struggles to find balance as she juggles work, her social life and her erotic fascination with insects.

title: Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender
overview: Avatar Aang, the world's last Airbender, learns of an ancient power that could save his culture from extinction. With the help of his friends, he embarks on a global quest to find it before it falls into the wrong hands and threatens to upend the peace they sacrificed everything to achieve.

title: The Belief
overview: In the twenty-second year of the Kangxi Emperor's reign (1683 A.D.), in an attempt to stop Zheng's blatant attempts at independence in Taiwan, the Kangxi Emperor sent Shi Lang, the governor of the Fujian Naval Division, to lead an army to collect Taiwan. An advance team from the imperial court paid a terrible price to lure Zheng's navy into a trap. Shi Lang led a large naval force to attack Penghu in a surprise attack, wiping out the main force of Zheng's army and eventually unifying Taiwan.

title: Meadowhawk
overview: When washed-up actor David Eastman participates in a comic convention in order to earn money for his granddaughter, he encounters his former co-star and rival Rick Majors for the first time in 40 years.

title: Apology
overview: Three friends find themselves in an unprecedented search for an unknown man around their hometown.

title: Homo Machina
overview: As a lonely man isolates himself, the line between the digital and physical world blurs.

title: Chainsaw Man: The Stage - Reze Arc
overview: The hugely popular manga "Chainsaw Man" by Tatsuki Fujimoto is being adapted into a stage play! The highly anticipated second installment "Reze Arc."

title: Love Under the Mistletoe
overview: Interior designer Grace (Lilley) runs a business with her best friend and her brother in the quaint town of Ivy Glen, but is too busy for a real relationship. Ryan (Bateman), a successful New York City financial adviser and Grace's former high school crush, returns home planning to sell his grandmother's historic St. Nicholas House. The mayor convinces him to revive the beloved "Ribbons and Bows" charity fundraiser and brings Grace on board to help. Working side by side to pull the event together, the former couple reminisces and feelings they once shared slowly resurface. But will this yuletide reunion lead to love under the mistletoe?

title: いってらっしゃいの花
Breakfast
overview: On the cusp of a big announcement, a frazzled mom prepares a glorious breakfast for her family. But, when they run for the door before even sampling her buffet, Mom takes matters into her own hands - holding them hostage until every scrap of food is gone.

title: Light Through The Dust
overview: When the 2011 Christchurch earthquake struck, tattoo apprentice Bonnie Singh was inside Southern Ink, the studio where she had finally begun chasing her dream. The tattoo studio collapsed and Bonnie, trapped in the rubble, suffered a broken back, a shattered neck, and a brain injury that would affect her for life.  With the help of fellow tattooist Jak Law, Bonnie is determined to push through physical and neurological limitations to master the craft of tattooing that once seemed out of reach. A story of resilience, reinvention, and the invisible scars we carry, this is not just a film about tattoos but instead is about what it means to rebuild a life and the importance of having a dream when everything has fallen away.

title: Summer Delivery
overview: In traditional Chinese culture, red eggs symbolize fortune and happiness. On a day filled with significance, seven-year-old Aileen, a country girl, sets off for the city, carrying a red egg—a precious gift for the one she holds dearest. When her bike falters midway through her journey, a quirky yet kind delivery driver unexpectedly becomes her guardian on this adventure. This poignant tale captures the bittersweet journey of growth.

title: RISE
overview: The year is 2099. With the evolution of AI bringing machines to a superior to human intelligence they have lived peacefully and in harmony together. Until now…

title: Replika
overview: After surviving a horrific car crash and losing his arm, an unstable family man develops a bizarre fascination for augmenting his body with bionic prosthetics.

title: Someone Special
overview: Rain is a young painter crippled with deep-seated violent tendencies who confronts his demons after an unexpected meeting with a therapist living one floor above him. The therapist conceals her own malignant vices behind smiles and warmth, and the two share secrets that neither is prepared for.

title: AEW Redemption 2026
overview: Redemption 2026 was the inaugural edition of All Elite Wrestling's annual Redemption professional wrestling pay-per-view, which took place on July 26, 2026, at the Bell Centre in Montreal, Quebec, Canada.

title: Taxi
overview: A man in his mid 50s becomes a Taxi driver to help pay for something, will he manage to?

title: Crying Over Dead Cats
overview: A person talking.

title: El pez que fuma
overview: In 1976, a 19-year-old actress becomes a symbol of scandal when she starts her career in The Smoking Fish, delivering the first-ever nude scene in Venezuelan cinema. The media crucifies her, turning her into a controversial figure. Decades later, she returns to the iconic film, now as the lead. As she embarks on the remake's production, her personal life spirals into a passionate affair with the married director and a complicated romance with the young male protagonist. Life and art intertwine as her real-world turmoil mirrors the love triangle she portrays on screen. More than just the professional redemption she seeks, The Smoking Fish will once again change her life in unexpected ways.

title: The Ultimate Linemarker
overview: We follow Borus, a road line marker who treats asphalt like a sacred canvas, as he passionately explains the emotional and deep importance of straight lines, proper spacing, and precision. His manager and a rival crew who see the job as “just paint” are brought into the world of Borus, who always has a new way of sharing his passion of the job. His world is thrown into chaos when a reckless young teammate commits the ultimate workplace sin: unauthorized road doodling. As Borus spirals over compromised line integrity, In the ultimate irony, he is “punished” with the assignment of his dreams — the very stretch of road he’s been dreaming about for years. For Borus, it’s not discipline. It’s destiny.

title: Masterpiece
overview: Two passionate lovers unite their artistic souls on a canvas, channeling their deepest emotions and shared experiences. As their painting evolves, it becomes a reflection of their connection and relationship.

title: Train of Thought
overview: A new work from emerging filmmaker and prolific train-goer Katie Edwards.

title: Gun Pilots
overview: Gun Pilots takes a compelling insider’s view into the rigorous world of U.S. Army Apache flight training. It follows student aviators as they confront the formidable challenge of mastering the AH-64 Apache—the most lethal attack helicopter ever built!

title: Home Movies: Inside the Making of Amélie
overview: Documentary on the making of Amélie

title: The Galactic Ghoul
overview: Space-conquering, saucer-aircraft explorer Captain Oscar Bravo, and his sly subordinate Lieutenant Foxtrot, are made prisoners of Queen Xaltalusia XXIII (Isabelle), after discovering a mysterious stone on their journey and being engulfed by her permanent and outlandish jail, Planet of the Toum, from where the cosmic crusaders must escape while fending off her heavy-duty military, and their own brotherly conflict, to restore love and peace in the Galaxy.

title: Schlüssel-Schloss-Witz
overview: Strange sounds emit from an apartment. An isolated man decides to investigate, shortly before being evicted himself.

title: Wham! 10 Days in China
overview: In 1985, Wham! were the first Western pop group to perform in communist China. George Michael and Andrew Ridgeley’s two concerts in Beijing and Guangzhou introduced live Western pop to Chinese audiences and marked a turning point for the band. For Wham!, the tour was more than music; it was a bold move to capture American attention and launch them into global superstardom, and it worked.

title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

title: Marvelous Mornings
overview: At her grandmother's funeral, Charlie learns that she already has a place reserved in the family vault. In search of an escape, she herself delivers the crate of disco vinyls her grandmother left to the wine merchant in a village in the south of France. In the deserted seaside resort, the records bring back bitter memories of lost loves. Here, time has a different value, and people are more bored than busy. Charlie only has eyes for Marina, the waitress at the pizzeria. Nothing predestined clumsy, overly sincere Charlie and wounded tornado Marina to mend fences together. But sometimes destiny reunites lost mermaids.

title: I Want Your Sex
overview: When fresh-faced Elliot lands an exciting job for renowned artist, icon and provocateur Erika Tracy, his fantasies come true as Erika taps him to become her sexual muse. But Elliot soon finds himself out of his depth as Erika takes him on a journey more profound than he ever could have imagined, into a world of sex, obsession, power, betrayal and murder.

title: The Gorals
overview: With 200 days left before college entrance exams, In-hye, who cares for the school's animal pen, spends her time lecturing a duck instead of studying. Seo-hee, punished for carrying a knife, joins her, and they discover an abandoned meadow where they lose the duck, Hee-seon. Meanwhile, teacher Kim Ah-tae forms a college interview prep group for four neglected students. On interview day, In-hye and Seo-hee ditch school to find Hee-seon, camping in the meadow and gradually learning to survive in the wild.

title: The Devil's Mouth
overview: A group of college friends' Thailand adventure turns deadly when they become trapped in submerged caves with a dangerous predator. As oxygen runs low, past conflicts emerge in their desperate fight for survival.

title: Filíocht Na Corcaí
overview: An intimate documentary showcasing the vibrant poetry scene of Cork City and the talented community of artists involved in these incredible nights.

title: Love/Bug
overview: A couple, affectionately naming each other Love and Bug, test the limits of their love living with each other for fifteen months.

title: He Who Saw the Abyss
overview: The gun pointed at the head is a delirium that expands into disorderly controlled chaos. “He Who Saw the Abyss” by Gregorio Gananian and Negro Leo, is like a car that enters the curve at 300km/h, but slowly. In an experimental whirlwind, moving between a noisy sound and an almost idyllic musicality, the film is structured out of a pile of images that seem as intimate as they are delirious, accelerating into a trance that is fragmented by a montage, signed by João Dumans and Gregorio Gananian, who strive to articulate an intense experience on the big screen.

title: Regretfully At Dawn
overview: In a small province in Thailand, the life of the former Thai veteran, Yong, casually seems like a typical old man. Even though he currently feels unwell, Yong spends every day with the dream of building a tree-house solely with his own hand, and raising an intelligent niece.

title: Andai Waktu Bisa Diulang Kembali
overview: Dinar falls for Faiz, who brings color to her dull life. Amid their romance, she faces mounting troubles—unpaid tuition, her late father’s debts, and her mother’s cancer. Then, Firman, a wealthy man, offers her an easy escape—but at the cost of betraying Faiz.

title: Ghost School
overview: Rabia, a ten-year-old Pakistani girl sets out to find why her only school in the village is closed. This fable is a ghost story with a tinge of magical-realism that explores corruption from a child's perspective.

title: За любовь
overview: A couple on the brink of divorce receives a magic bottle that grants wishes, turning their lives upside down.

title: Ashes
overview: One night. One gun. Two estranged brothers reunited by the man who killed their parents and a choice that will either damn them both or lead one to grace.

title: The Fabulous Time Machine
overview: In the arid Brazilian hinterland, girls play poised between their mothers’ difficult pasts and fantastic dreams for the future. In a place where men are still seen as giants compared to women, the girls cross the threshold from childhood into adolescence.

title: The Elder Eagle
overview: The old man refuses to leave his native village, abandoned by other residents long time ago. To stand up to the local authorities, who have their own plans for the beautiful mountain land, he lures by deceit his son and grandchildren from Moscow – they must help him turn the village into an eco-touristic place. The family members get a chance to reconnect with their roots, see each other in a new light, and become a close, loving family.

title: Paroxysm
overview: After a drug deal goes horribly wrong, Celia is pulled into a surreal odyssey of self-discovery. Drifting through a distorted world, she encounters temptation, desire, and paranoia as her sense of self begins to unravel and the line between reality and fantasy begin to blur around her

title: Death Note - The Musical
overview: If you had the power over life and death, what would you do?  Now, boldly reimagined for the London stage in close collaboration with the original Japanese producers, HoriPro, this new musical features an electrifying score by Tony, Grammy and Emmy nominee Frank Wildhorn, lyrics by Jack Murphy and a book by Ivan Menchell. Death Note: The Musical is set to be the theatrical event of the summer.  When brilliant student Light Yagami discovers a notebook with the power to determine who lives and who dies, his mission to reshape society quickly spirals out of control and attracts the attention of the elusive and ruthless detective L. What begins as justice descends into obsession and forces both Light and L to confront the limits of morality itself.

title: Tomb Quest
overview: In a suburban basement, five old friends meet on the night of their friend's funeral to fulfill his final request: finish the Tomb Quest role-playing campaign they abandoned after their high school graduation.

title: Pentacide
overview: In 1999, a series of grisly, religiously inspired killings struck the country repeating every five years, now in the present day (2024) the story follows two detectives who are trying to solve the biggest serial killer case the UK has ever seen!

title: GIANT - The Play
overview: In the summer of 1983, just before the release of The Witches, Giant imagines a tense meeting between Roald Dahl and his American and British publishers as they scramble to contain the fallout from his public denunciation of Israel and defence of the Palestinians in a review of a book on the 1982 Lebanon war. Filmed live onstage at the Harold Pinter Theatre in London's West End in 2025.

title: Addicted to Change
overview: In a near future Britain, at a biotech lab on the brink of collapse, three interns invent a cognitive enhancing drug. They begin full scale manufacture, only to become targets of government forces who view their breakthrough as a threat.

title: The Ungrateful Tenant
overview: It’s 2026 Auckland, New Zealand, through the black-and-white lens of the German expressionist silent era. If it weren't for the online group chat and the overused electric heater, the city’s 100-year-old bungalows with no insulation would make you believe it’s the 1920s.  The Ungrateful Tenant follows an anxiety-ridden millennial renter who dreams of one day buying his own house. When his paranoid frustration comes to a head, he kicks out his ‘nightmare’ flatmate, only to be struck back by instant karma, sending him on a cursed odyssey in and out of flats across Auckland. Experience the brutal absurdity of the housing crisis in slapstick fashion.

title: Screen of the Dead
overview: In a quiet backyard, Gaby finds her friends frozen over their phones. When they finally look up, an ordinary afternoon spirals into a bloody, absurd fight for survival.

title: PAW Patrol: The Dino Movie
overview: The PAW Patrol crash land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs after their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. When the Patrol’s archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining to exploit the island's natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they’ve done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.

title: Jimmy
overview: In November 1948, James Baldwin left New York and, thanks to a fellowship grant, relocated to Paris. The 24-year-old writer would spend most of the next decade there, escaping American racism and his own social alienation, ensconcing himself in the city’s Algerian quarters and the community of Left Bank artists in Saint-Germain-des-Prés, and writing his first books.

title: DC
overview: Rebel Devadas joins forces with Chandra in a dangerous world where passion and peril collide. Their turbulent alliance demands bloodshed and tests loyalties as survival becomes the ultimate stakes in their fight.

title: Ish
overview: Twelve-year-old best friends, Ish and Maram wrestle to hold onto their friendship, in the wake of a traumatic police stop & search. As the ripples take hold, the boys try to make sense of the men they are becoming – and how ‘letting go’ can be the hardest part of growing up.

title: Wild Inside
overview: On February 2, 2023, Flaco — a male Eurasian eagle-owl, the largest species of owl in the world — was discovered missing from his cage at the Central Park Zoo in Manhattan. What follows when Flaco, who had lived his entire life in captivity, was released in New York City is a surprising story revealing the delight, concern, and fascination of millions in the city and beyond.

title: KUMLAN
overview: This is footage recorded in 2005 and released years later. It concerns a low-budget paranormal show that was investigating the possible existence of a mysterious creature from local folklore in the forests of Thailand.

title: Crayon Shin-chan the Movie: Very Bizarre! My Yokai Vacation
overview: Shin-chan and his family visit his father's home town of Akita in order to view the Omagari Fireworks Festival. When a strange incident to causes the residents of “Yokai Land” to begin running wild throughout Akita and the rest of Japan, Shin-chan and company are lured to “Yokai Land” for an unusual adventure.

title: Bonecos de Estado em Golpes de Plástico
Kids' Festival! All the Heroes of Justice Appear
overview: Kids' Festival! All the Heroes of Justice Appear was a televised celebration of tokusatsu heroes in 1976.

title: Ip Man: Kung Fu Legend
overview: In 1950s Hong Kong, British merchants and Chinese triads have joined forces to expand their territory, forcibly demolishing factories without regard for public welfare. This move draws fierce opposition from Ip Man, standing up for the workers, he faces pressure from all sides. Framed for murder, he is sent to prison. Within the prison walls, the triads set multiple deadly traps. Can Ip Man overcome these trials, escape the danger, and clear his name?

title: Mala bestia
overview: An orphaned girl named Atenea lives in isolation with other children. When adopted by a family, she glimpses a chance at belonging, but her fear of losing this newfound home drives her to extreme measures.

title: Dead & Breakfast
overview: The story follows Danielle Stanbreaker, a paranormal consultant investigating a strange supernatural occurrence at a local Bed and Breakfast that ultimately ends up being real.

title: Transylvania Tapes
overview: In 1997, Romanian actress Silvia Enescu mysteriously disappeared while searching for family property in Transylvania. All she left behind were a collection of home movies: the TRANSYLVANIA TAPES. Now, Silvia's daughter Mara travels from Los Angeles to Romania to discover what happened to her mother. With the help of her cameraman friend Dylan, Mara documents her journey, which takes her from the streets of Bucharest to the medieval town of Sighisoara, deep in the heart of Transylvania. Unearthing the truth about her mother comes at a terrible price, as Mara must escape an ancient family curse.

title: Tokyo Nightfall
overview: A young man named Amenashi is haunted by the death of his younger sister Anna, who took her own life after witnessing a classmate’s suicide in high school. Burdened by guilt, he continues to chase her memory. One night, he learns of a secret mass suicide event held in a Tokyo nightclub and is drawn to it. His close friends, Nozu and Hattori, grow suspicious and follow him inside. In a closed-off space filled with despairing youths, the three attempt to escape, but are ultimately forced to confront the emotions they have each been carrying deep within.

title: Super Duper
overview: On the night of a highly anticipated Super Duper Moon, two people embark on an intimate nighttime journey together. As clouds obscure the sky and the night stretches on, anticipation gives way to waiting, uncertainty, and presence. With the spectacle they planned for absent, the meaning of the evening must be negotiated through behavior, silence, and choice—revealing whether love is sustained by symbols or by staying.

title: Ma Ago Timi Pani
overview: Ma Ago Timi Pani is a Kumude Hidto Hero Banna movie song

title: One Guy, Too Many Dates
overview: After one too many disastrous dates, a talented software engineer creates a women-centered app where users can anonymously review their dating experiences. What begins as a simple idea quickly turns into a viral phenomenon, igniting chaos between men and women online, attracting media attention, and complicating Emily’s own love life. In a world where everyone has opinions about dating, Emily discovers that building an app about relationships might be easier than surviving one.

title: Consequence
overview: After risking a patients life while unfit to operate, a surgeon tackles his guilt as his daughter's wedding approaches.

title: Molder Man
overview: Thrown into a shapeless prison, the Molder Man must face the music.

title: Snoopy Presents: There's No Place Like Home, Snoopy
overview: When Snoopy's beloved doghouse goes missing, he tries to track it down, and learns what makes a house feel like home.

title: Toe Tags
overview: TOE TAGS – Feet as Fetish, Fragment, Ghost  From Phallacies, which stripped the male body of shame and censorship, to Analogies, exploring the taboo of the anus, Toe Tags steps into a new obsession: the foot.  Feet become fetish, memory, and horror: a woman inherits her mother’s shoes (CLARA), a transvestite searches for feet that fit (THE PERFECT PAIR), a child avenges his monstrous father (PODOPHILE), a schizophrenic confuses nail visions with reality (NAILS), a man dances one last time with his wife’s ghost (SHOES NUMBER 43), and a mermaid mourns the tail she abandoned (PART OF YOUR WORLD).  ToeTag – where obsession walks, steps, and sometimes, kills.

title: The Secret Battlefield
overview: In April 1941, months before the Pacific War begins, Japan’s brightest young elites, bureaucrats, military officers, and civilians, are secretly assembled at the Total War Research Institute. Tasked with simulating a conflict against the United States, they confront harsh realities through intense analysis.

title: Mimic
overview: A car in the night. Two voices talking about death. Outside, something decided to listen.

title: Roadkill
overview: An unknown man is on the loose, murdering people and leaving them on the side of the road. You must be careful when driving, or you could be next.

title: The Delivery
overview: On his final delivery of the day, a courier finds that the address leads to a house that seems long abandoned. But the package carries a specific instruction: deliver in person...

title: Intralight
overview: INTRALUZ follows Ella, a woman caught between memories and symbols that come to life, reminding her of past moments and unresolved emotions. Through poetic encounters and elements of magical realism, Ella journeys through her inner world, confronting fears, desires, and doubts. This voyage allows her to reconcile with herself and accept who she truly is, discovering the freedom that emerges when one dares to look within.

title: Doomed
overview: A psyhological thriller story about a boy who is trying to find himself

title: One Day: Look At The Sky
overview: A reflective soul journeys through memories of love, loss, and identity, ultimately embracing humility and the eternal cycle of transformation, reminding us that even fallen stars can rise again.

title: Merci Charlotte !
overview: In a romantic jazz bar atmosphere, Émile’s first date takes an unexpected turn when he realizes the woman he’s meeting has lied about her age. What starts as an uncomfortable surprise swings into laughter, vulnerability, and an unlikely connection that lingers long after the last note fades.
